title.narrative: Output 4.2. Strengthened capacity of enterprises and their support systems to enhance productivity and sustainability

description.narrative: Through a partnership with employers’ organizations at entity level and other established networks of local stakeholders, in 2023 seven help desks to support start-ups were established at local level. The helpdesks provide support to SMEs (including training) in the field of business digitalization and OSH. The Union of Employers Organizations in Republika Srpska has set up an on-line learning platform for enterprises (Digitalize Your Business). Additionally, value chain actors in the textile/clothing/leather/footwear (TCLF) sector have operationalized the ILO SCORE (Sustaining Competitive and Responsible Enterprises) methodology. It has resulted in the development and implementation by participating SMEs of Enterprise Improvement Plans, with a focus, among other dimensions, on occupational safety and health (OSH). With resources made available by the Delegation of the EC in Bosnia and Herzegovina through a joint project with UNDP and Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ), the ILO supported the establishment of the helpdesks and the implementation of Generate Your Business Idea (GYBI) and Start Your Business (SYB) trainings. The ILO also facilitated the piloting of SCORE in 22 SMEs, with both technical and financial assistance. The ILO facilitated Business Continuity Planning (BCP) training and on-site consultations with SMEs, resulting in development of Business Continuity Plans; and OSH training, resulting in the updating of the OSH Rulebook. Through a partnership with the global workers’ organization IndustriAll, the ILO developed a set of concrete recommendations to ensure that the TCLF sector can realize a green and digital transition, while also remaining resilient and competitive, with special attention to workers’ specific concerns and needs.
